title: Agent Commit
description: Write commit messages with the coding agent you already use (Claude Code by default). One click per repository, so it always lands in the right repo, even in multi-root workspaces.

title: Agent Restore
description: Reopen VS Code and every terminal goes back to the agent session it was running: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor CLI, Kimi and OpenCode. Automatic, per tab, no menus.

title: Midnight Graphite
description: A quiet dark theme for long coding sessions: graphite-blue background, soft contrast and a restrained palette across editor, UI and terminal.

title: Workspace Root Terminal
description: Open a terminal at the root of your multi-root workspace (the folder that holds the .code-workspace file) in one click, no folder picker.

title: PhiTeX ⚡ Instant
description: Instant LaTeX preview: pages update as you type, typeset by PhiTeX in VS Code itself.

title: DiffCraft: Clipboard & Active Selection Diff Pro ⚖️
description: 1-Click compare clipboard with selection, compare two active editor tabs, compare text files, and structural JSON diff in a side-by-side diff viewer without touching Git.

title: DockerCraft: Dockerfile Analyzer & Compose Studio Pro 🐳
description: Instant Dockerfile generator, multi-stage build analyzer, security/layer optimizer, and docker-compose health inspector directly in VS Code.

title: IconCraft: App Icon & Favicon Generator Pro 🎨
description: 1-Click PWA, iOS, Android, and Web Favicon suite generator from any PNG/SVG directly in the VS Code Explorer context menu with manifest.json and HTML tags.

title: JWT Lens: Token Decoder, Inspector & Expiry Checker Pro 🔑
description: Inline JWT token detector, hover decoder, real-time expiration countdown, payload claims inspector, and expired token security alerts directly in VS Code.

title: SnippetCraft: Visual VS Code Snippet Manager Pro ✂️
description: Visual snippet generator and interactive manager for VS Code. Convert any code selection into reusable snippets with tab stops ($1, $2), placeholders, and language targeting without manual JSON escaping.

title: Typst Package Dev Kit
description: Extensions for developing Typst packages, including Rust/WASM plugins, with a justfile workflow.

title: DuanAPI - AI code agent
description: AI code agent powered by DuanAPI (DeepSeek models via thuehay.com)

title: MyBatis SQL Highlight
description: SQL syntax highlighting for MyBatis XML mappers, including CDATA, dynamic tags, parameters, and comments.

title: Minecraft Bedrock Language Editor
description: Editor de archivos .lang de Minecraft Bedrock: tabla origen/destino, herencia de versiones, comparación de carpetas, detección de textos, glosario, nombres propios, IA, borrador persistente, backups, languages.json y colores por familia de claves.
